title: Closed Curves with a Nondegenerate Frenet Frame
exact_target: How many traversals of a plane oval permit a nearby nondegenerate curve in higher dimension, and do they determine a strict lower bound for frame length?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 6500006 (AMR-064-0006). CC BY 4.0.
